newsitem.title: GERMANY: German April air cargo up 8.5pct, Jan-April rises.
newsitem.headline: German April air cargo up 8.5pct, Jan-April rises.

text.p: The German air cargo market grew 8.5 percent in April to 172,320 tonnes, figures from the German airports association ADV showed.
German air cargo exports grew 10.6 percent in April while imports increased 6.7 percent, the monthly ADV traffic report said.
The fastest-growing airports last month were Duesseldorf, Munich, Berlin and Cologne, it showed.
The German air cargo market grew 6.5 percent to 673,251 tonnes over the first four months of the year, the report added.
